参议院已经批准建立一支常设的多国联合武装部队，意在防卫星海共同体。这支“泛星系防卫军”将会从所有共同体成员国当中征募兵员，成员国要求贡献自己的一部分资源来支持舰队的建设。

泛星系防卫军现在已经处于[custodian.GetName]——现任监管人——的直接控制之下，有关人士担忧这支庞大的舰队会成为镇压反对意见的工具。然而，也有不少人对其创立拍手称快，称这支舰队“始终活跃在星系防卫的最前线”。
texts.en:
The Senate has ratified the creation of a standing multinational military force intended for the defense of the Galactic Community. This "Galactic Defense Force" will recruit its personnel from all Community members, who are also required to contribute resources towards the construction of its fleets.

With the GDF being placed under the direct command of the [custodian.GetName], the current Galactic Custodians, some fear that this potentially massive armada could be used as a tool of oppression. Others, however, applaud its creation, referring to it as "the galaxy's first line of defense."

texts.zh:
参议院已经批准建立一支常设的多国联合武装部队，意在防卫星海共同体。这支“泛星系防卫军”将会从所有共同体成员国当中征募兵员，成员国要求贡献自己的一部分资源来支持舰队的建设。

由于星系全境陷入混乱，并受到了意在消灭所有智慧生命体的势力的长期威胁，各界衷心希望泛星系防卫军能够对敌人发动打击，以维系星海共同体的边疆安全。星海监管人[custodian.GetName]将直接指挥舰队，负责领导这次行动。
texts.en:
The Senate has ratified the creation of a standing multinational military force intended for the defense of the Galactic Community. This "Galactic Defense Force" will recruit its personnel from all Community members, who are also required to contribute resources towards the construction of its fleets.

With the galaxy engulfed in turmoil and under constant threat by forces that seek to exterminate all sapient life, it is hoped that the GDF will be able to bring the fight to the enemy and secure the borders of the Community. They will be placed under the direct command of the [custodian.GetName], the Galactic Custodians.

由于星系全境陷入混乱，各界衷心希望泛星系防卫军能够进一步扩编增长实力，以应对失落帝国为了征服星系全境而派遣出来的庞大舰队。星海监管人[custodian.GetName]将直接指挥舰队。
texts.en:
The Senate has ratified the creation of a standing multinational military force intended for the defense of the Galactic Community. This "Galactic Defense Force" will recruit its personnel from all Community members, who are also required to contribute resources towards the construction of its fleets.

With the galaxy engulfed by war, it is hoped that the GDF will expand to become strong enough to challenge even the vast fleets being thrown around by the Fallen Empires in their petty squabbles for galactic dominance. They will be placed under the direct command of the [custodian.GetName], the Galactic Custodians.

label.zh: 本星系将会变成一个更加安全的地方。
label.en: The galaxy will become a safer place.

label.zh: 这支可怜的舰队将会被歼灭，直到最后一艘舰船损失殆尽。
label.en: This pathetic fleet will be exterminated to the last ship.
